note: Written by the review agents. Proposals are never applied automatically: you approve them.

reviewers.name: Code reviewer
reviewers.job: Hunts bugs, bad data and silent failures

findings.text: Today's top ideas aren't being graded: board_track.log() skips any stock logged in the last 21 days, even if that earlier row was skipped, and the upgrade check needs entry_date to be empty, which skipped rows never have. PNFP and MU have only old skipped rows, CVE.TO only a 10-22 watch row, and TSM was a top idea on 8 straight runs (10-26 to 10-29) but is recorded only as a skipped watch row. The Record can't judge the picks you actually see

Two sector naming systems are mixed: brain.stock_metrics() falls back to Yahoo's label when the stock list has none, so 58 stocks use names like 'Technology', 'Basic Materials' and 'Healthcare' next to 'Information Technology', 'Materials' and 'Health Care'. This beats the one-per-sector rule (TSM + SNX were both top ideas 10-26 to 10-29; AUGO + DSV.TO are both in today's high-upside waiting list) and splits the Scanner's sector filter

Earnings are only checked for about 80 stocks (top 60 plus the board), yet the verdict runs on all of them: 60 of today's 81 'Buy candidate' stocks (MATX, SNPS, CRC...) never had their date looked up, but still say 'passes every check' and 'Add' if you own them. In earnings season this matters: 38 of the checked stocks report inside the trade window. They also escape the -3 earnings penalty, which tilts the ranking toward unchecked stocks

Evening run scores US stocks on yesterday's prices: the 10-23 board (made 9pm New York) has SNX, SBLK and PNFP charts ending 10-22 while Canadian stocks end 10-23, and the 10-21 and 10-22 evening runs did the same. Plans and buy zones are a day old even though the header says today. Update 10-31: all 5 evening runs since 10-26 had same-day US prices, but no code changed, so this could come back

The 'morning' run (cron 12:00 UTC) actually started around 16:15 UTC, after the US open, so US stocks get a half-finished day as their 'close' (10-23 run: US as_of 10-23 at 12:15pm New York). Scores, buy zones and the Record's logged ideas then rest on a midday price. Update 10-31: BTSG was logged as a top idea from the 10-30 midday run, and by that evening it ranked #26 and was off the list
paper.publish() wraps the price download for stocks that left the universe in 'except Exception: pass', so if Yahoo fails those bubbles quietly lose their prices with no message in the Agents log
High-upside picks get the earnings warning added twice (brain.py, the loop after high_upside()): RBA's risk list shows 'earnings on 2026-11-09, inside the trade window' two times
Broken price bars (zero or blank prices) could poison every calculation
A Yahoo hiccup could mark a real stock as 'missing' for a week
Earnings lookups that failed were cached as 'no earnings', hiding real report dates
Finished trades stopped being graded before their 15-day return was known
Run could publish a board without SPY (the market benchmark)
Infinite or blank numbers could break the dashboard's data files
Earnings check only covered the top 60, not every stock that ended up on the board
Excel exports were not git-ignored like CSVs

reviewers.name: Method reviewer
reviewers.job: Challenges how stocks are scored and picked

findings.text: Old targets are creating '+50%' stocks after bad news: GOOGL fell from $320.89 to $279.84 on its report, but its $429 target was read on 10-27, before the report, so it shows +53% (it was +34% at the price the target was read). AUGO is the same: $81.82 down to $66.22, +55% now vs +26% before. Neither would qualify for the high-upside lane otherwise, and 64 ranked stocks are now 10%+ below the price their target was read at. The 35% split guard is too loose to catch this

The Canada bonus is more than the 'tie-breaker, never decisive' that weights.yaml calls it: Canadian stocks are 12% of the ranked list but 13 of the top 50 today. Taking off the 3 points leaves 4 of the top 50 (19 vs 7 in the top 100; rough estimate from today's scores)

Record so far: 16 finished trades and all 16 hit the stop (average -9.7%, 0 targets hit). That's too early to judge (need 30), and it leans negative because stops finish first: 8 of the 9 running top and high-upside ideas are up, average +5.6%. 9 of the 16 were Canadian gold and silver miners stopped on 10-22 and 10-23, so they were really one bet, not 9 separate results

AUGO is 'Avoid' in the Scanner (too volatile, moves 8.0% a day) but sits in the high-upside waiting list with a 'Watch' chip. Its daily move is exactly on the lane's 8% limit, it beat 0 of its last 4 quarters, and the insider buying counted as a catalyst was at $86.48, 23% above today's price

MU's plan target is +42% in 15 trading days (1254.61, the 52-week high), nearly 3x its own realistic upside of 15%, and it makes the plan look like 3.7x reward for the risk. level_plan() jumps to the next resistance instead of stopping at the 2x-risk level. ITRI (+48%) and ASTH (+41%) have the same problem on the watchlist, and no logged idea has reached its target yet

RBA is a 'ready' high-upside pick while its own main verdict says 'Watch: below its 200-day average and lagging the market'. It fell from about $110 to $84 in 60 days, is 28% behind the market over 3 months and has momentum 26. high_upside() only checks timing and the 50-day line, so a falling knife can get through

The high-upside lane never waits for earnings: all four of today's names report inside their 30-day plan (FTK 11-03, RBA 11-09, DSV.TO 11-12, MRVL 12-01). A top idea in the same spot would be told 'wait for the report', so the riskier lane takes on the bigger gamble

Record: only 2 finished trades, so it's too early to judge (need 30). Both were Canadian gold/silver miners stopped out within days (TXG.TO -8.2%, DSV.TO -8.5%), and both are back on today's board, with TXG.TO ranked #1 at conviction 76
Stale analyst targets after a big drop made fallen stocks look like huge upside
Mega-caps won the analysts pillar on raw revision counts; now per analyst
Value compared a bank's P/E with a software company's; now within its industry
Analysts cutting estimates was ignored; now a penalty and an automatic Avoid
Room back to the 52-week high counted as 'upside' (it is usually where the stock fell from)
High-upside lane accepted a single catalyst; now needs two and a turned-up chart
Watchlist could fill up with one industry; now max two per industry
Fundamentals are today's values, so the backtest can't test them honestly (look-ahead)

reviewers.name: Design reviewer
reviewers.job: Checks the dashboard on desktop and phone

findings.text: The Record tab hides losing trades: record.js never shows record.closed, and its score tiles wait until a 15-day return exists (scorecard.finished()). So it still says first results come 'in about three weeks' and lists only running ideas, mostly green, while TXG.TO, DSV.TO, SNX, SEI and ATEC (-35%) have already stopped out. The tab looks better than the real results

The big number on an idea card is the raw analyst upside, which the System tab says it doesn't trust above +40%: MU's card shows +77% (target range $361 to $3,000), while the score uses 15% and the plan target is +42%. headlineUpside() in ui.js should show a number the system stands behind

'#' means two things on the Command screen: idea cards count 1-2-3 (CVE.TO is '#1'), while the watchlist below shows the overall rank (SNX is '1', and the dossier calls CVE.TO 'RANK #3'; MU is card #3 but rank 12). It looks like the watchlist outranks the top ideas, with no explanation why

Rows in the Your holdings panel can't be reached by keyboard: command.js gives .hold-row a click and a key handler but no tabindex or role, so Tab skips them and screen readers don't announce them as clickable. Top idea cards also have tabindex but no role

Paper tab 'Sell now (last close)' looks like it does nothing: it sets the sell day to paper.json's as_of (10-23), but US prices stop at 10-22, so simulate() keeps the trade open and the button stays. Tested in paper.js: the status stays 'open'

Bubbles are just 'RBA paper trade' to a screen reader: the dollar value, return and 'TARGET ✓ / STOPPED' are in a hidden SVG or CSS ::after, the selected bubble has no aria-pressed, and focus doesn't move to the detail panel that opens
Stock dossier: focus and keyboard handling, close race, back button on phone
Scanner re-drew the whole table on every keystroke; pillar names were cut off
Holdings value fell back to nothing when Questrade left the market value blank
Leftover fantasy names and a level-up popup that didn't fit the style
Phone inputs zoomed the page (text under 16px)
Data files could be served stale by the browser cache

proposals.title: Post-earnings drift
proposals.why: Stocks that beat and rise on the report tend to keep drifting up for weeks. A clean, well-studied catalyst for the high-upside lane.

proposals.title: Short-interest squeeze setup
proposals.why: Heavy short selling plus rising estimates plus a breakout can produce fast +30-50% moves. Higher risk, belongs in the high-upside lane only.

proposals.title: Sector rotation strength
proposals.why: Favour ideas in the 3 strongest sectors over the last month; most stocks move with their sector.

proposals.title: Weekly review routine
proposals.why: A scheduled Claude agent re-reviews code, scoring and the track record every week and adds findings and proposals here. Runs Saturdays 9am; it can only edit this file.

proposals.title: Cooldown after a stop-out
proposals.why: Don't re-list a stock as a top idea or high-upside pick for about 10 trading days after its logged trade hits the stop. Both finished trades so far (TXG.TO, DSV.TO) were stopped out and came straight back onto the board.

proposals.title: Price-date badge per market
proposals.why: Show 'US prices as of … · Canada prices as of …' next to the board date. Right now the header says 10-23 while US numbers are from 10-22, and you can't see that from the dashboard.

proposals.title: Earnings gate for the high-upside lane
proposals.why: Hold a high-upside name in 'waiting' until its report has passed, as top ideas already do. ATEC was logged 10-19 with its 10-29 report date already known, then gapped from a $9.82 stop to $6.86: -35%, almost 5x the planned risk (one trade, so this rests on the logic more than the sample).

proposals.title: Fresh targets for the board's names
proposals.why: Re-read analyst targets each run for the top 60 or so stocks, and for any stock that just reported or fell 10%+, instead of waiting for the weekly cycle. GOOGL and AUGO qualified as +50% stocks only because their price fell after the target was read.

proposals.title: Cut the Canada bonus from 3 to 1
proposals.why: 3 points roughly triples Canadian names in today's top 50 (13 vs 4), far more than a tie-breaker, and 9 of the 16 stop-outs so far were Canadian. The sample is small and those 9 were one gold and silver drop, so this rests mainly on the ranking effect.
